paragraphs.text: Dean Kianne was an elf druid teacher and dean at the Quandrix College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios .
Brilliant and eccentric, Kianne was one of Arcavios's preeminent mana scholars. An elegant elf woman, she wore spectacles and had her hair pulled into a high knot atop her head.

Kianne visited and studied bizarre mana phenomena around Arcavios, from snarls and star arches to nameless ancient shrines. She loved to share her wild mana theories with anyone who would listen. Kianne believed in using mathematics to understand the physical nature of reality better. She emphasized practical magic that improved daily life through applied calculations. She rolled her eyes at Dean Imbraham 's theories, dismissing him as living in an imaginary world.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Kianne was compleated and killed.
The House made an illusion of Dean Kianne as a trap for Zimone Wola .
After her death, Kianne's role as Dean of Substance was taken over by Nev .
